diagnostic_scope: Previously closed RGBNT201 real training logs only; no new forward, retrieval evaluation, runtime poll or source change.
limits: Epoch summaries average logged batch diagnostics, not a fresh inspection of attention vectors or images.
Nominal cosine fields are AMP dot products; they can exceed one. No clamping or exact unit-cosine claim is made.
Entropy divided by log(128) is descriptive; rounding can exceed one slightly. No new acceptance gate is introduced.
Similar activity weakening in both conditions cannot isolate weight decay, architecture, numerical precision or any other unique cause.
The single-seed pretrained/random package comparison does not establish text information is universally useless.
